post.description: Always answers the same way, whether or not the address is already registered: a registration form that says 'already taken' is a free account checker. Blocked by the age gate (403 auth/age_restricted) for India under 18 and the EU under 16.

post.description: Rotation with a 60-second grace: presenting the previous token inside the window replays the same new pair, presenting it after the window revokes the whole family.

Takes the refresh token rather than the access token, so a client whose access token has already expired can still sign out. Always 204: an unknown token must not be a way to test whether a token is live.
The workspace is bound into the access token; there is no X-Workspace-Id header (07 section Conventions, THREAT-MODEL T4). Membership is re-checked here.

delete.summary: Revoke one session (and its refresh-token family)

post.description: Offered to a sign-up blocked by the age gate (D60), until a verifiable parental-consent flow ships.

get.description: Stores the PKCE verifier and the originating client for 10 minutes, then redirects to Google. `client` decides where the callback sends the browser back to.
Exchanges the authorization code, links or creates the identity, and redirects on with a single-use handoff code. Tokens are never put in a redirect URL.

post.description: When the callback reported `status=registration` this call must also carry `dateOfBirth` and `jurisdiction`: Google does not supply a date of birth and D60 requires one before an account exists.

post.description: Returns an 8-character user code from an alphabet with no ambiguous glyphs, a 10-minute expiry and a 5-second polling interval. At most five flows may be in flight from one address.

post.description: 400 with `auth/authorization_pending` until the code is approved, `auth/slow_down` when polled faster than the interval, `auth/expired_token` after 10 minutes and `auth/access_denied` when the user declines.

get.description: The approval screen's data: host application, device facts, address and a coarse location, so a user can tell a device on their desk from one on somebody else's.

info.title: Aksharo API
info.description: Errors use the envelope `{ error: { code, message, details?, requestId } }` with `namespace/slug` codes (CONTRACTS section 8).

priority.description: Lower runs first; derived from the workspace's plan.

jobKey.description: Deduplication key: one live job per (workspace, key).

attemptId.description: Identifies this run of the job.

creditsChargedTenths.description: Credits in tenths: the hold while running, the charge once finished.

maxQueueWaitMs.description: Milliseconds this job may wait in `queued`.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page.

error.description: Present only when the check failed.
